findings.finding: Key: From sum condition a+x=2(b+y) and a−b+x−y=10 ⇒ b+y=10, a+x=20. Set x=20−a, y=10−b. Solve integer equations a(20−a)=4b(10−b) and a(15−a)=b(15−b) with a≤15,b≤10. Unique solution (a,b)=(10,5). Product=50.

Key: From Bob’s “sum & product equal after 5‑sweet transfer” get B+b=10, A+a=20. Then a=20−A, b=10−B. Solve A(20−A)=4B(10−B) and A(15−A)=B(15−B) with A≤15, B≤10. Unique integer solution: A=10, B=5. Product=50.
